title: As Pro 97 tucture pack
description:
AS Pro 97 tucture pack for all pvp players 
Yt AS Pro 97
body:
AS Pro PvP Pack is a smooth and optimized Minecraft Java texture pack made for PvP players. It includes a small custom totem for better screen visibility, different sword designs, custom potion textures, and a clean GUI for a better gaming experience.

This pack is designed to improve FPS and give smoother gameplay during PvP fights, Bedwars, Skywars, and Survival. The textures are simple, stylish, and easy to use without lag.

Features:

- Small Totem
- Custom Swords
- Different Potion Textures
- Clean PvP GUI
- FPS Boost
- Smooth and Lightweight Design

Perfect for Minecraft Java PvP players who want better performance and a cool look.
